rules.positiveConsideration: Compare a familiar corn–soybean alternation with the farmer's actual history.
rules.possibleDisadvantage: The familiar pattern may not meet a soil-cover or diversity priority on its own.

rules.positiveConsideration: Explore a cereal-rye cover window after corn before soybean for soil cover.
rules.possibleDisadvantage: Fall establishment and spring termination add work; cover uses water while growing.

rules.positiveConsideration: Explore winter-killed oats after soybean before corn for a fall cover window.
rules.possibleDisadvantage: Short fall growth window and no living spring cover after winterkill.

rules.positiveConsideration: Explore a small-grain and perennial-legume phase instead of only annual row crops.
rules.possibleDisadvantage: Requires a forage outlet, additional equipment or services, and multi-year commitment.

rules.positiveConsideration: A cover crop may be possible after soybean.
rules.possibleDisadvantage: Cereal rye directly ahead of corn needs special termination and disease-risk review; oats are the lower-complexity question to explore first.
